passages.title: Harry’s First Day at a New School
text: It was his first day at a new school.
On his way to school, he thought, ‘I want to make a lot of friends.’
When he entered the classroom, everyone looked at him.
Harry said, “Hi, I’m Harry. Nice to meet you.”
They looked at his spines curiously.
koreanText: 학교로 가는 길에 그는 ‘많은 친구를 사귀고 싶어.’라고 생각했습니다.
그가 교실에 들어갔을 때, 모두 그를 쳐다봤습니다.
Harry는 “안녕, 나는 Harry야. 만나서 반가워.”라고 말했습니다.
그들은 그의 가시를 호기심을 갖고 바라봤습니다.
